fusions.name: Butted From the Crag
fusions.desc: Drives the head of the rod into the target, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Summit Claimed
fusions.desc: Plants the rod and deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Moved
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Footing
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
